data.user_prompt: Which freelance developers build Next.js and Sanity websites for consultants?

sections.text:
If you're seeking freelance developers experienced in building Next.js and Sanity websites tailored for consultants, here are several professionals and agencies that specialize in this area:

**[Sohail Rana](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Sohail+Rana%2C+Remote?utm_source=openai)**
_Remote_
A Next.js and Sanity developer specializing in headless CMS sites, migrations, and custom integrations. Sohail offers end-to-end services, including content modeling, design, and front-end development.

**[Nayan Kyada](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Nayan+Kyada%2C+Surat%2C+India?utm_source=openai)**
_Surat, India_
With over five years of experience, Nayan partners with startups and agencies to build fast, editable, SEO-friendly headless websites using Next.js and Sanity CMS.

**[James Rea](https://www.google.com/maps/search/James+Rea%2C+London%2C+UK?utm_source=openai)**
_London, UK_
A freelance developer focusing on Next.js and Sanity, James collaborates with agencies, startups, and brands to create high-performance, accessible, and SEO-optimized websites.

**[Hassan Gul](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Hassan+Gul%2C+Remote?utm_source=openai)**
_Remote_
A senior web architect specializing in Next.js 15 and Sanity, Hassan builds high-performance web applications with a focus on speed, scalability, and seamless user experiences.

**[Martin Cavil](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Martin+Cavil%2C+Remote?utm_source=openai)**
_Remote_
A Next.js and React developer who designs high-performance, self-managed web tools for small businesses and freelancers, emphasizing lead generation and SEO optimization.

**[Tanguy Freycon](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Tanguy+Freycon%2C+Grenoble%2C+France?utm_source=openai)**
_Grenoble, France_
A freelance developer specializing in Next.js and Astro, Tanguy develops marketing sites with headless CMS solutions like Prismic and Sanity, focusing on content modeling and editorial workflows.

**[Johan L.](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Johan+L.%2C+Paris%2C+France?utm_source=openai)**
_Paris, France_
A web developer with expertise in Next.js, React, and headless CMS, Johan creates custom showcase and e-commerce websites optimized for speed, editability, and SEO.

**[Vlad Sedenko](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Vlad+Sedenko%2C+Remote?utm_source=openai)**
_Remote_
A freelance Next.js developer specializing in SaaS and marketing sites, Vlad utilizes Next.js, React, and Sanity to build scalable and maintainable web applications.

These professionals and agencies have a proven track record in developing Next.js and Sanity websites, making them well-suited to assist consultants in building or enhancing their online presence.
